name: 8 Reale OBAL
description: If you find yourself in Orange Beach looking for a touch of mystery and sophistication, exploring the world of speakeasy cocktails might be just the thing for you. 8 Reale is a hidden gem that offers a unique experience, transporting you back to the days of Prohibition but with a modern twist. At 8 Reale it's not just about the cocktails; it's about the ambiance, the secrecy, and the craftsmanship. The mixologists behind the bar take their craft seriously, creating delicious and intriguing concoctions. From the classics like the Old Fashioned or the Sidecar to more contemporary creations featuring fresh, local ingredients, we cater to a wide range of tastes. Whether you prefer your cocktails strong and spirit-forward or light and refreshing, there is something for everyone behind the hidden vaulted door of our establishment. If you're up for an adventure and ready to explore a different side of the Orange Beach nightlife, step into 8 Reale and let the magic of the cocktails transport you to another time and place. Cheers to hidden delights and unforgettable sips with us!
